[MedFront Clinic - General Information & Operational Policies > ## 1. Operating & Opening Hours (Schedule)]
## 1. Operating & Opening Hours (Schedule)
The clinic is open for outpatient appointments and visits on the following schedule:
- **Weekdays (Monday to Friday):** Open 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST for routine visits, primary care consultations, and laboratory services.
- **Weekends (Saturday):** Open 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST (Urgent care walk-ins & scheduled follow-ups only).
- **Weekends (Sunday):** Closed (On-call triage physician available for phone inquiries and emergencies).
- **Holidays:** Closed on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.

[MedFront Clinic - General Information & Operational Policies > ## 2. Location & Parking]
## 2. Location & Parking
- **Address:** 742 Evergreen Medical Pavilion, Suite 400, Springfield, MA 01103
- **Public Transit:** Accessible via Metro Line 2 (Pine Street Station), Bus routes 14 and 27.
- **Parking:** Dedicated patient parking garage located behind Building B. First 2 hours are free with clinic validation at the reception desk. $4/hour thereafter. Accessible (ADA) parking spaces available adjacent to the main entrance elevators.

[MedFront Clinic - General Information & Operational Policies > ## 3. Contact & Communication]
## 3. Contact & Communication
- **Main Reception Desk:** (555) 019-8234
- **Prescription Refill Line:** (555) 019-8235 (Please allow 48 business hours for standard refill approvals)
- **Fax:** (555) 019-8239
- **Emergency Situations:** If experiencing severe chest pain, shortness of breath, sudden numbness, or life-threatening symptoms, patients must immediately hang up and dial 911 or proceed to the nearest emergency department.

[MedFront Clinic - General Information & Operational Policies > ## 4. Appointment Policies]
## 4. Appointment Policies
- **Arrival Time:** New patients must arrive 15 minutes prior to appointment time for check-in and document verification. Established patients should arrive 10 minutes prior.
- **Cancellation & Rescheduling:** Appointments must be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice may incur a $50 late cancellation fee.
- **No-Show Policy:** Three consecutive no-shows without notification may result in dismissal from the practice.
- **Telehealth Visits:** Telehealth consultations are available for non-urgent consultations, follow-ups, and routine lab reviews via the MedFront Patient Portal. Patients must be located within the state at the time of the call.

[MedFront Clinic - Insurance & Billing Guidelines > ## 1. Accepted Insurance Plans (In-Network)]
## 1. Accepted Insurance Plans (In-Network)
MedFront Clinic is currently an in-network provider for the following major commercial and government health plans:
- **Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS):** In-network for PPO, EPO, and Traditional indemnity plans. Out-of-network for BCBS Blue Care HMO plans requiring primary care referral unless pre-authorized.
- **Aetna:** In-network for Choice POS II, Open Choice PPO, and Aetna Select.
- **UnitedHealthcare (UHC):** In-network for Choice, Choice Plus, and Medicare Advantage Choice PPO.
- **Cigna:** In-network for Open Access Plus (OAP) and Network PPO plans.
- **Medicare:** In-network for Original Medicare Part B. We accept assignment on all covered Medicare services.
- **Medicaid:** In-network for MassHealth Standard and MassHealth CarePlus. Prior authorization required for specialized diagnostic imaging.

[MedFront Clinic - Insurance & Billing Guidelines > ## 2. Out-of-Network & Self-Pay Pricing]
## 2. Out-of-Network & Self-Pay Pricing
For patients without active insurance coverage or choosing to receive out-of-network care:
- **New Patient Consultation (Comprehensive):** $220 flat fee (includes baseline vitals and 45-minute physician evaluation).
- **Established Patient Follow-Up:** $130 flat fee (30-minute consultation).
- **Urgent Care / Same-Day Walk-In Visit:** $160 flat fee.
- **Routine Preventive Annual Checkup:** $180 flat fee (excluding specialized bloodwork/labs).
- **Self-Pay Discount:** A 15% discount is applied if balance is paid in full on the date of service via debit, credit card, or cash.

[MedFront Clinic - Insurance & Billing Guidelines > ## 3. Copayment and Deductible Policies]
## 3. Copayment and Deductible Policies
- **Copay Collection:** All applicable specialist or primary care copayments are mandatory and collected at the time of check-in before seeing the physician.
- **High-Deductible Health Plans (HDHP):** If deductible has not been met, patients will be billed following insurance adjudication. Estimated deductible deposit of $75 is collected at check-in.
- **Accepted Payment Methods:** Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, HSA/FSA cards, and personal checks.

[MedFront Clinic - Insurance & Billing Guidelines > ## 4. Prior Authorizations & Referrals]
## 4. Prior Authorizations & Referrals
- Patients enrolled in HMO plans are responsible for obtaining an active referral from their Primary Care Physician (PCP) at least 48 hours before specialty appointments.
- Our prior authorization team coordinates approvals for MRI, CT scans, and specialty medications within 3 to 5 business days.

[MedFront Clinic - Clinical Preparation & Procedure Guidelines > ## 1. Fasting Guidelines for Blood Tests]
## 1. Fasting Guidelines for Blood Tests
Certain blood panels require strict dietary preparation to guarantee diagnostic accuracy:
- **Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) & Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP):** Fasting for 10 to 12 hours prior to blood draw is recommended.
- **Lipid Panel (Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL, LDL):** Fasting for 12 hours is mandatory. No food, juices, coffee, or milk.
- **Fasting Blood Glucose / Hemoglobin A1c:** Fasting for 8 hours is required for fasting glucose tests. Plain water is permitted and encouraged.
- **Hydration:** Patients should drink 1 to 2 glasses of plain water before arrival to facilitate venous blood collection.
- **Medications during fasting:** Patients should continue taking routine prescription blood pressure and cardiac medications with a small sip of water unless specifically instructed otherwise by their physician.

[MedFront Clinic - Clinical Preparation & Procedure Guidelines > ## 2. Imaging & Diagnostic Preparation]
## 2. Imaging & Diagnostic Preparation
- **Ultrasound (Abdominal):** Nothing to eat or drink for 8 hours prior to the examination to reduce bowel gas interference.
- **Ultrasound (Pelvic / Renal):** Drink 32 ounces of plain water 1 hour prior to scan; do not empty bladder before the procedure.
- **MRI Screening:** Patients must complete the metal safety screening questionnaire before entering the magnet suite. Notify staff if you have cardiac pacemakers, neurostimulators, metal clips, cochlear implants, or occupational metal fragment exposure. Wear loose, comfortable clothing without zippers, metallic threads, or snaps.
- **CT Scan with Contrast:** Fasting for 4 hours prior to scan. Ensure blood creatinine/eGFR laboratory results within the last 30 days are on file to evaluate kidney function before contrast dye administration.

[MedFront Clinic - Clinical Preparation & Procedure Guidelines > ## 3. General Pre-Visit Preparation]
## 3. General Pre-Visit Preparation
- **Documentation to Bring:** Government-issued photo ID, current physical insurance card, list of all current prescription and OTC medications (with dosages), and previous relevant diagnostic imaging discs or reports.
- **Pediatric Patients:** Minor patients under age 18 must be accompanied by a legal parent or guardian for all consultations.
